verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at developers.openai.com that indexes the API, Codex, Agents and other docs. The Cookbook has its own llms.txt index, and doc pages are served as markdown (.md URLs), so an agent can be pointed straight at agent-oriented docs. The .md.md 404 is just a malformed double-extension URL and does not count against this. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths, there is no evidence of an llms-full.txt or similar full-content bundle, and there is no independent corroboration of agents actually using these docs.
